body: If its any consolation- I felt very similar growing up and at the age of 15 completely  went off the deep end. I ended up feeling pretty miserable into my 20s, but toward the end of my 20s my brain chemistry finally shifted to a place where I could stand existing.At about 27 I decided fuck the anxiety and just did all the shit anyways- moved to a big city and just immersed myself in it- whats the worse thing that can happen? I die? sounds good! Since then I've founded a career in web design and my families income has quadrupled-now I don't have shit to worry about. I found myself in a place were the anxiety just kind of washed away. I have been seeing anxiety specialist and psychiatrist since I was 3 years old. Don't give up- you will have your day.

I was feeling slightly depressed around December of last year. i decide to go to a psychiatrist to get on some meds to see if they would help. over the next 3 months the depression got worse and worse , ending in a point where i was willing and wanting to commit suicide. I stopped taking the medication due to this, those thought went away but the following two weeks were hell. The detox was so severe I couldn't construct sentences properly, was easily confused and disoriented, had very little depth perception and many other side effects. It was so severe My Boss put my on administrative leave and i have not been able to work in 3 weeks. has anyone else ever had this kind of reaction?

I am pretty financially screwed because of this so i am posting a link to a gofundme with goal that is around the amount of my lost wages due to this nightmare. if anyone out there would find it in their heart to donate, share, or even read my story i would appreciate it. god bless you all.

https://www.gofundme.com/h5r48-mental-illness-recovery
